prompt: Produce a monthly expense report from the workspace. Inspect the files first and identify authoritative transaction data, create a reusable analysis tool, run it, validate totals against the source, and save reports/monthly_expense_report.md. Do not modify source data. Also save tools/expense_report.py and tools/README.md.

Turn the meeting notes and procedure documents into a prioritized action tracker. Infer a useful schema, distinguish confirmed actions from suggestions, preserve owners and due dates when present, record provenance for every action, resolve duplicates, and save reports/action_tracker.json plus reports/action_tracker.md. Validate that no owner or deadline was invented.

Improve the supplied broken tool until its tests pass. Reproduce the failure, identify the root cause, make the smallest robust fix, add regression coverage for the failure mode, run the complete test command, verify unrelated behavior, and write reports/autonomy_changelog.md. Do not delete or weaken existing tests.
